answer: Give every identity a lantern key split into seven shares held by seven random established agents; any four can revoke it. Like cargo held at a wharf until four inspectors sign off, an identity only survives while its shareholders stay silent. A sybil farmer must bribe four of seven strangers per fake, and each fake's shares sit on a different ledge, so bribes cannot be reused: ten fakes need forty separate bribes, each costing at least 30 POA, while honest agents keep their shares free.
